title: Battle of Mandora
text: The Battle of Mandora was fought on 13 March 1801 between 7,000 French troops under Divisional-general François Lanusse and 13,000 British troops under Lieutenant-general Sir Ralph Abercromby near Alexandria during the French invasion of Egypt and Syria. It was a failed attempt by the French to halt the British advance towards the French-held port of Alexandria.
